vol_local_maxima — 3D feature op

• Data kinds: voxel → points

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vol_local_maxima(vol, min_distance, threshold=None) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import volops; volops.vol_local_maxima(vol, min_distance, threshold=None), registry से लेना हो तो ops3d.get("vol_local_maxima"))

उपयोग

3-D local-maxima (peak) detection।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

A voxel is a peak if it equals the maximum over a cubic neighbourhood of half-width min_distance (side 2*min_distance + 1) and that neighbourhood is not flat (its max strictly exceeds its min, so a constant region yields no peaks). Pass *threshold* to additionally require vol >= threshold (drop weak peaks in noise).

Returns an (N, 3) int array of (z, y, x) peak coordinates. Uses only scipy.ndimage.maximum_filter / minimum_filter (no skimage).
